title: Identification | Aeroplan Login | OTP Bypassed | AC Wallet | Eligible | APPR EL-01
goal: Validates that when a customer is logged into their Aeroplan profile, the system bypasses OTP authentication entirely and proceeds directly to passenger selection. Also tests AC Wallet payout since customer has active Aeroplan.

checkpoints.step: Validates that when a customer is logged into their Aeroplan profile, the system bypasses OTP authentication entirely and proceeds directly to passenger selection. Also tests AC Wallet payout since customer has active Aeroplan.
